title: Qualify finite Euclidean resolution and projection cancellation boundaries
commitMessage: feat: qualify finite Euclidean boundary audits and close M6 W02 C03 S01

contribution.summary: Qualify S01-T2 finite Euclidean boundary audits with compiled public-API RED, 52 GREEN, 351 retained scientific tests, four Math regressions and three SHA-matched isolated preview.6 NuGet consumers. Close S01 only; keep S02/S03, C03, W02 and M6 open. RS094 retry 1 corrects a pre-attempt TextContains formatting mismatch (geometry consumer uses Version =, not Version=); zero attempts allocated.
contribution.value: Provide explicit conservative 1e-12 binary64 relative displacement and normalized dot-signal screening without claiming exact error bounds or condition-number theorems. Preserve caller-managed common Cartesian units, T1 numeric budgets, deterministic refusal reasons, no partial results, and distinct local NuGet-only verification.
debtChanges: Observe one compiled, independently failing missing-public-boundary-audit RED before staging source; a compiler error is not a RED observation.
Recover the RED and verify 52 separate GREEN tests for 2D/3D finite norms, distances, projections, dimensions, cancellation and fail-closed refusals.
Refuse relative displacement below a conservative 1e-12 ratio when nonzero; accept identical coordinates and nonnegative ratios above one without false rejection.
Refuse a positive-sum near-orthogonal projection dot-signal ratio below 1e-12; a mathematically orthogonal case may be conservatively rejected.
Treat ratio floors as heuristic warning policies only, not binary64 error bounds, actual cancellation measurements or certified condition numbers.
Preserve direct FiniteGeometry64 T1 semantics and caller-managed Cartesian linear units; no implicit units, geodesy or frame conversions.
Retain 25 qualified S01-T1 and 326 C01/C02 scientific tests plus four relevant Math regression projects and transfer architecture validation.
Build one real local preview.6 scientific NuGet package; inspect archive, version, dependency absence and byte/SHA-256 identity.
Require three independently restored source-free eight-probe consumers using only cleared local NuGet feeds and matching archive SHA-256.
Close precisely S01-T2-R/G/V, S01-T2 and S01 across accepted backlog and native plan; keep S02/S03, parent C03, W02 and M6 unfinished.

Correct an unallocated RS094 pre-attempt payload refusal: the geometry consumer declares Version = with spaces while the special consumer declares Version=; check each exact file syntax before staging.
contribution.nextAction: After durable RS094 success, prepare RS095 on M6-W02-C03-S02-T1: bounded direct discrete Fourier transform and linear convolution with explicit DFT sign/inverse conventions, independent impulse/convolution oracles and local package integration. Retain S02-T2, S03, original C03 and M6 gates.
